problems: No new states and no rebel states were needed; all counterpart slugs exist in polities.csv.

Matching events are needed in other dossiers: golden-horde (Azerbaijan 1357-1358, Chobanid Tabriz 1357), muzaffarids and sarbadars (Nishapur to the Kartids c. 1376; Fars and Isfahan from the Injuids 1357), timurid-empire (Soltaniyeh 1384, Tabriz 1386, Baghdad 1393-1394, 1401-1405, Kartid Herat 1381), qara-qoyunlu (Tabriz 1406-1410, lower Iraq 1410-1432), mongol-empire and ilkhanate (Kartid vassalage 1244-1349), beylik-of-hamid (Teke split 1321), kingdom-of-cyprus (Antalya 1361-1373; its 1363-1486 shape holds three Antalya cells), ottoman-empire (Teke 1391-1402 and 1423; Dulkadir 1515; its shape lacks Teke 1424-1428), mamluk-sultanate (Malatya, excluded from the Dulkadir shape).

Cliopatria rows that disagree with the pages: Chobanids runs to 1362 (page 1357) and still covers Azerbaijan; Qara Qoyunlu covers Azerbaijan from 1375 (Jalayirid Tabriz until 1386); Kartids to 1384 (page 1381); Injuids shape lacks Shiraz and Isfahan and runs to 1362 (page 1357); Jalayirid row ends 1401 (dynasty to 1432); Teke row runs to 1428 (page 1423); the allegiance of the Jalayirids to the Timurid Empire 1375-1394 is unsupported.

WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, not raw text; quotes in notes are as that summary returned them. The plain 'Muzaffarids' page is only a disambiguation (use Muzaffarids_(Iran)); the Injuids dossier opened three pages against a budget of 1-2 (the Chobanids page dates the 1350 attack and the 1342 Isfahan takeover).
Native-script names were left empty throughout (the extracts did not return them); rulers lists were extracted only for the Jalayirids and omitted for the other five states.
